description: Defines a location within the game world, such as a city, dungeon, or room.

name.description: The user-facing name of the exit, e.g., 'A dark path leading north'.

description.description: A short description of the exit.

locationRef.description: A strong reference to the destination location record.

description.description: A detailed description of the location, its atmosphere, and notable features.

image.description: An optional image representing the location.

type.description: The classification of the location, used for game logic and UI.

parentLocationRef.description: A reference to a parent location, for nesting (e.g., a room inside a building).

exits.description: A list of exits from this location to others.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for realm-specific properties (e.g., {'isSafeZone': true}).
